___NOTE___: THIS IS A TEMPLATE FILE - COPY TO config.json AND FILL WITH YOUR DATA
___WARNING___: config.json is IGNORED in .gitignore - This file contains sensitive data (passwords, proxy credentials)

___INSTRUCTIONS___.step_1: Copy this file to 'config.json' in the same folder
___INSTRUCTIONS___.step_2: Update the values below with YOUR specific parameters
___INSTRUCTIONS___.step_3: Replace SENSITIVE fields marked with [CHANGE_THIS] tags
___INSTRUCTIONS___.step_4: Do NOT commit config.json to Git - it's in .gitignore

connection.___url_note___: The website URL you want to connect to (e.g., https://chat.openai.com, https://claude.ai, https://genspark.ai)
connection.___cookies_file_note___: Path to JSON file with browser cookies - get these from DevTools (Application > Cookies)
connection.___adapter_name_note___: Options: 'chatgpt', 'claude', 'genspark', 'qwen', 'generic' - determines which adapter to use

browser.___headless_note___: true = invisible browser, false = visible browser (useful for debugging)
browser.___hide_automation_note___: true = hide browser automation signs, false = allow detection (hide_automation is recommended)
browser.___user_data_dir_note___: Path to browser profile directory or null for temporary profile
browser.___user_agent_note___: Custom User-Agent string or null for default. Example: 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) Chrome/120.0'
browser.___viewport_note___: Browser window size in pixels - recommended minimum 1280x800
browser.___extensions_note___: Array of Playwright extension paths - usually empty for standard usage

proxy.___SECTION___: Proxy settings - Leave as-is if not using proxy
proxy.___enabled_note___: true to use proxy, false to connect directly
proxy.___host_note___: ⚠️ SENSITIVE: Proxy server address (IP or hostname) - Example: 159.255.38.108
proxy.___username_note___: ⚠️ SENSITIVE: Proxy authentication username or null if no auth required
proxy.___password_note___: ⚠️ SENSITIVE: Proxy authentication password or null if no auth required

generic.___description___: Generic/Universal adapter - use for unknown sites

defaults.___interval_after_note___: Delay in seconds after each task completes (avoid rate limiting)
defaults.___timeout_note___: Maximum seconds to wait for response from AI (increases for long responses)
defaults.___retries_note___: Number of retry attempts if a task fails

ui.___SECTION___: UI/GUI settings (saved automatically on window close)
ui.___ui_note___: These are auto-saved when you close the GUI window - no need to edit manually

logging.___level_note___: Options: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL - more verbose = more logs
logging.___max_size_note___: Maximum log file size in bytes (10MB default) before rotation
